capabilities.label: ISO creation and structural verification

evidence.claim: CI workflow completed successfully on the revision under test
builder validates El Torito BIOS/UEFI entries and required staged files

limits: structural verification does not by itself prove a successful interactive userspace session

capabilities.label: Koronos boot smoke test

evidence.claim: QEMU boot matrix is the boot evidence source

limits: CI emulator success does not prove all physical platforms boot

capabilities.label: Live userspace and Aurora readiness
limits: do not promote to userspace-ready until the booted ISO demonstrates shell, service manager, storage and Aurora interaction end-to-end

capabilities.label: Native VFS-backed syscall layer and user-memory validation

evidence.claim: kernel source tree is the implementation area

limits: hosted POSIX-shaped adapters are not native VFS syscalls

capabilities.label: Windows/Linux/Darwin ABI compatibility

evidence.claim: SDK programming-model boundary and remaining gaps

limits: catalog entries and API-shaped adapters are not complete OS ABI implementations

capabilities.label: Objective-C compilation

evidence.claim: CI compiles architecture-specific Objective-C object files

limits: object compilation does not prove macOS linking, frameworks, execution or Apple ABI compatibility

capabilities.label: C# and .NET on Chimera

evidence.claim: SDK CI builds the managed project using installed .NET

limits: this is not a native Chimera CLR/JIT port and does not mean the runtime is installed in the ISO

capabilities.label: Intel Mac and Apple Silicon hardware
limits: target metadata is not proof of boot, platform drivers or macOS application compatibility

capabilities.label: Symmetric multiprocessing on physical/logical CPUs
limits: sequential simulation, multiple virtual CPU labels or scheduler unit tests do not establish SMP; require parallel execution on two or more CPUs, AP bring-up evidence, synchronization tests and stress/conformance results

capabilities.label: R8192/C8192 experimental virtual architecture
limits: virtual register lanes and simulation are not dedicated 8192-bit silicon

compiled: artifact path or CI artifact evidence
userspace-ready: storage and network checks where claimed
real-smp: at least two independently running CPUs
